findings.defect: Unsupported cheek-rim ledge and locally thin indexing rim
findings.evidence: Front/iso show an overhanging cheek shelf. Overhang report327mm2; two thin wallbands around upper cheeks22.1/20.6mm2.
findings.repair: Use constant outward offset for >=1.2 rim stock and taper the rear of the cheek lip into the rounded head with a self-supporting skirt.

observation: Inspected front, top and iso. Rounded head and three upward-open magnet pockets are coherent; cheek indexing rim visibly projects as a ledge beyond the underlying head. Numeric checks locate broad unsupported underside and two thin rim walls.
